decision.observation: Wheel room with its huge ornate woven wheel, brass ribbed ball on a curled arm top-right, wooden chock at base-left. Two black mushrooms at left with flat caps at about ledge height; the mossy mound and crescent emblem behind.
decision.hypothesis: Mushroom caps are standable in some rooms only; if the flat cap at (~740,525) is standable here, it gives height toward the mossy ledge above (~y420) and the left wall's stone-brick band — a vertical route not yet used in this room.
decision.memory: Abilities (S/D/F/V) all inert with no silk/tools; only walk/jump/attack work. Test whether this room's caps are standable.
